segments.ja334:1.1: Gavaṃ ce taramānānaṃ, jimhaṃ gacchati puṅgavo;
segments.ja334:1.3: Sabbā tā jimhaṃ gacchanti [sabbā gāvī jimhaṃ yanti (sī. syā.)], nette jimhaṃ gate sati.
segments.ja334:2.3: So ce adhammaṃ carati, pageva itarā pajā;
segments.ja334:2.5: Sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ dukhaṃ seti, rājā ce hoti adhammiko.
segments.ja334:3.1: Gavaṃ ce taramānānaṃ, ujuṃ gacchati puṅgavo;
segments.ja334:3.3: Sabbā gāvī ujuṃ yanti [sabbā tā ujuṃ gacchanti (pī. a. ni.4.70)], nette ujuṃ gate sati.
segments.ja334:4.3: So sace dhammaṃ carati, pageva itarā pajā;
segments.ja334:4.5: Sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ sukhaṃ seti, rājā ce hoti dhammikoti.
